mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is today's balanced dish. Overcast conditions persist tonight near Verona Area High School with a warm temperature of 76 degrees that feels like 83. Under the waxing crescent moon, skywatchers can view the International Space Station passing northwest to southeast tonight at 11:54 PM.

The City of Verona is reminding apartment residents that they can participate in sustainability efforts by dropping off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop located at 1220 East Verona Avenue.
This Thursday, July 16th, you can enjoy Concerts in the Park at Century School Park. Bring your lawn chairs and blankets for this free public concert.
According to the weekly police report, on Friday, July 10th, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle collision at Old PB and Whalen Road, resulting in minor injuries to the cyclist.
To wrap up your updates, Culver's of Verona is currently closed and will open at 10:00 AM. Today's Flavor of the Day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
